def _h_ares_identity_seal(
    inp: AresIdentitySealInput,
    *,
    workspace_id: str,
    run_id: str,
    record_resolver: IdentityRecordResolver | None,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
    record = resolve_identity_record(
        record_ref=inp.record_ref,
        workspace_id=workspace_id,
        run_id=run_id,
        resolver=record_resolver,
    )
    authority = seal_ares_identity_authority(
        workspace_id=workspace_id,
        run_id=run_id,
        record_id=record.id,
        record_version=record.version,
        record_digest=record.digest,
        identity_lock=record.identity_lock,
        master_sheet=record.master_sheet,
        cast_sheets=record.cast_sheets,
    )
    return authority, record.emitted_at.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat()
